study_identification_part.si_4_title: Mapping the Heterogeneous Phenotype of Schizophrenia and Bipolar Disorder Using Normative Models

nm2_1_modeling_methods.detail: Gaussian process regression was used to estimate normative brain aging models. The models predicted regional gray and white matter volumes from age and sex. Cross-validation (10-fold) was performed on healthy individuals, and the trained model was applied to patients.
nm2_1_modeling_methods.supporting_text: We estimated a normative brain aging model by using gaussian process regression to predict regional gray and white matter volumes across the brain from age and sex using voxel-based morphometry-derived gray and white matter maps. ... Normative models were estimated using gaussian process regression, yielding coherent measures of predictive confidence in addition to point estimates.

nm2_2_response_variable.answer: sMRI: GMV; sMRI: WMV; sMRI: CT; sMRI: SA
nm2_2_response_variable.detail: Primary analysis used VBM-derived gray matter volume (GMV) and white matter volume (WMV) maps. Supplementary analyses additionally employed FreeSurfer-derived cortical thickness (CT) and pial area/surface area (SA) measures to better characterize volumetric differences in the cortex.
nm2_2_response_variable.location: Wolfers2018.pdf.md: Methods / Normative Modeling (lines 65-69); yoi180064supp1_prod.pdf.md: eMethods / Normative modelling on cortical thickness and surface area (lines 47-49)
nm2_2_response_variable.supporting_text: We estimated a normative brain aging model by using gaussian process regression to predict regional gray and white matter volumes across the brain from age and sex using voxel-based morphometry-derived gray and white matter maps. To supplement this analysis and to characterize volumetric differences more precisely, we also estimated normative models using Freesurfer-derived cortical thickness and pial area measures.

nm2_3_explanatory_variables.detail: Age and sex were used as the only explanatory variables (predictors) in the normative models. These covariates were used consistently across both VBM-based and FreeSurfer-based analyses.
